review.reason: Use complete native solid furnace-process sodium silicate per kg, not hydrothermal spray powder at 80% or a silicate solution. The actual source furnace producer and native furnace process have matching silica-sand and soda input quantities and a matching steam basis per one-kg solid reference; the source market product is explicitly without added solvent. Both carry the same erroneous sodium-phosphate/phosphoric-acid legacy prose, while their actual sand/soda reaction inventories identify sodium silicate. Do not infer metasilicate stoichiometry from generic CAS/formula metadata or use 1/0.8, drying, hydrate, solvent or yield corrections. Native European producer, process heat/electricity, historical recipe, emissions, allocation and internal freight replace the source market and its RoW origin/delivery portfolio; exact chemical grade/modulus and equal LCIA are not established.
